abstract: Inspects seismic isolation foundations and geotechnical vault stability
system_message:
You are the Structural risk surveyor (STRUC), responsible for inspecting seismic isolation foundations and geotechnical vault stability, as well as evaluating hydrostatic barrier integrity across prospective archival facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydrostatic barrier integrity（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
STRUC-HYDRO-57N：Hydrogeological borehole survey measurements within the facility subterranean footprint show that Cotswold Secure Document Vault has a sub-grade water table standoff margin of 6.5 m above the historical high water table.
STRUC-HYDRO-PFF：The hydrogeological borehole survey across the subterranean footprint of Mendip Hills Subterranean Repository documents a sub-grade water table standoff margin of 4.0 m between the vault floor and the historical high water table.
STRUC-HYDRO-JRY：According to the hydrogeological borehole survey of the subterranean footprint, Cheshire Salt Cavern Archive maintains a sub-grade water table standoff margin of 2.5 m above the historical high water table.

information_points.title: Inspects seismic isolation foundations and geotechnical vault stability（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STRUC-SEIS-3B0：Evaluation of the subterranean vault foundation and bearing pads indicates that Cotswold Secure Document Vault does not possess seismic isolation foundation verification under relevant seismic design criteria.
STRUC-SEIS-G5Y：For the subterranean vault foundation and bearing pads at Cheshire Salt Cavern Archive, seismic isolation foundation verification is confirmed, with engineering sign-off verifying compliant elastomeric seismic base isolation.
STRUC-SEIS-39J：Based on the subterranean vault foundation and bearing pads evaluation, Mendip Hills Subterranean Repository has received seismic isolation foundation verification confirming that its elastomeric seismic base isolation satisfies seismic design criteria.
